cues.en: If you've been alive for the past ten years, you've surely heard of two planes.
cues.zh: 如果你过去十年里活在世上，肯定听说过两款飞机。

cues.en: The Airbus a three eighty and Boeing seven eighty seven Dreamliner.
cues.zh: 空客A380和波音787梦想客机。

cues.en: These two planes have dominated news cycles worldwide
cues.zh: 这两款飞机一直占据全球新闻头条

cues.en: because they're both intensely innovative.
cues.zh: 因为它们都极具创新性。

cues.en: The a three eighty is the largest passenger plane to have ever existed while the Dreamliner is one of the most efficient and has an unrivaled focus on passenger comfort. Concealed by all the fanfare, however, is a much deeper story on economics,
cues.zh: A380是有史以来最大的客机，而梦想客机则是最高效的机型之一，并且对乘客舒适度的关注无与伦比。然而，在所有这些喧嚣背后，隐藏着一个更深层的故事，关于经济、

cues.en: innovation,
cues.zh: 创新，

cues.en: and how the airline industry works.
cues.zh: 以及航空业是如何运作的。

cues.en: So believe it or not, work on the Airbus a three eighty began back in 1988.
cues.zh: 所以信不信由你，空客A380的研发工作早在1988年就开始了。

cues.en: More people were flying than ever and airports weren't getting all that much bigger. Airbus eyed the success of the Boeing seven forty seven and needed a bigger aircraft to compete.
cues.zh: 乘飞机的人比以往任何时候都多，而机场并没有变得大多少。空客看到了波音747的成功，需要一款更大的飞机来竞争。

cues.en: At first, Airbus considered making a super wide jet by placing two a three forty fuselages side by side, but later opted for the design we see today, a fully double decker jet. An a three eighty can hypothetically carry as many as 868
cues.zh: 起初，空客考虑通过将两个A340机身并排放置来制造一架超宽体客机，但后来选择了我们今天看到的设计——一架全双层客机。A380在假设的全经济舱配置下最多可搭载868

cues.en: people in an all economy configuration.
cues.zh: 人。

cues.en: Although the densest in practice is 615
cues.zh: 尽管实际中最密集的配置是615

cues.en: seats. This is more than double that of the seven eighty seven. Airbus decided to focus on making a high capacity aircraft because they believed in the hub and spoke model of aviation.
cues.zh: 个座位。这比787的两倍还多。空客决定专注于制造高容量飞机，因为他们相信航空业的枢纽辐射模式。

cues.en: With the hub and spoke model, passengers traveling from smaller airports, we'll use Hartford, Connecticut as our example, to a long haul destination such as London, England, will need to connect through a hub.
cues.zh: 在枢纽辐射模式下，从较小机场出发的乘客——我们以康涅狄格州哈特福德为例——前往如英国伦敦这样的长途目的地，需要通过一个枢纽中转。

cues.en: Passengers would likely take a short flight to New York, Atlanta, or Chicago to catch their transatlantic flight to London. Obviously, this is inefficient for the passenger. On almost all routings between Hartford and London, passengers have to fly away from their destination in order to catch their transatlantic flight.
cues.zh: 旅客通常会先短途飞往纽约、亚特兰大或芝加哥，再搭乘跨大西洋航班飞往伦敦。显然，这对旅客来说效率很低。几乎所有从哈特福德到伦敦的航线，旅客都得先飞离目的地，才能搭上跨大西洋航班。

cues.en: However, for airlines, there's conceivably an advantage.
cues.zh: 不过，对航空公司来说，这倒可能是个优势。

cues.en: Let's say, just for the sake of explanation, there are only six airports in the entire United States.
cues.zh: 为了方便解释，假设全美国只有六座机场。

cues.en: New York, Boston,
cues.zh: 纽约、波士顿、

cues.en: DC, Los Angeles, San Francisco, and Seattle.
cues.zh: 华盛顿、洛杉矶、旧金山和西雅图。

cues.en: If an airline had one flight from every destination to every other
cues.zh: 如果航空公司开通从每个目的地到其他所有目的地的航班，

cues.en: they would need to run 16 routes.
cues.zh: 就需要运营16条航线。

cues.en: If they just have one hub airport on each coast, we'll say New York and LA, they just need to have one route from each secondary airport to each hub and one transcontinental
cues.zh: 如果他们在东西海岸各设一个枢纽机场，比如纽约和洛杉矶，那只需要开通从每个次级机场到每个枢纽的航线，再加一条跨大陆的

cues.en: hub to hub route, five in total.
cues.zh: 枢纽到枢纽航线，总共五条。

cues.en: Obviously, there will be quite high demand on the one transcontinental
cues.zh: 显然，那条跨大陆航线会有相当高的需求，

cues.en: route, so airlines can put a large aircraft such as the a three eighty on that route to fulfill its demand.
cues.zh: 所以航空公司可以在那条航线上投入A380这样的大型客机来满足需求。

cues.en: Since its release, the a three eighty has often been placed on those long haul high demand routes known as trunk routes. The second busiest long haul route in the world, Dubai to London, sees eight a three eighties a day and that's in addition to five smaller planes that fly that route.
cues.zh: 自投入运营以来，A380常被安排在那些长途、高需求的航线上，也就是所谓的干线航线。全球第二繁忙的长途航线——迪拜到伦敦，每天有八架A380执飞，此外还有五架较小机型飞这条航线。

cues.en: The Dreamliner serves a very different purpose.
cues.zh: 梦想客机（Dreamliner）的服务宗旨截然不同。

cues.en: It's a pretty modest sized plane. It can only hold around 220 passengers in a typical configuration.
cues.zh: 它是一架相当小巧的飞机，典型配置下只能容纳大约 220 名乘客。

cues.en: Its composite construction makes it extremely light and fuel efficient, which helps reduce operating costs. In the late nineteen nineties, Boeing started to see slower sales on their large seven forty sevens and seven sixty sevens and started to consider what to build next. They initially looked at creating a plane called the Sonic Cruiser, which would have had the same fuel efficiency as conventional aircraft while flying 15%
cues.zh: 其复合材料结构使其极其轻便且燃油效率高，有助于降低运营成本。在二十世纪九十年代末，波音发现其大型的 747 和 767 销量放缓，开始考虑下一步建造什么。他们最初考虑制造一款名为“音速巡航者”（Sonic Cruiser）的飞机，它的燃油效率与传统飞机相同，但飞行速度快 15%

cues.en: faster,
just under the sound barrier. Airlines were initially enthused.
cues.zh: 略低于声速。各大航空公司最初对此非常热心。

cues.en: However, after the attacks on September 11 and the rising cost of fuel, airlines asked for fuel efficiency rather than speed.
cues.zh: 然而，在 911 事件发生和燃料成本上升之后，航空公司要求的不是速度，而是燃油效率。

cues.en: The seven eighty seven delivered on that promise by reaching up to a 102
cues.zh: 787 兑现了这一承诺，其每座每加仑燃油效率高达 102

cues.en: miles per gallon per seat compared to the a three eighty's paltry 74 miles per gallon per seat.
cues.zh: 英里，而 A380 的每座每加仑燃油效率只有可怜的 74 英里。

cues.en: The Dreamliner also has an absolutely
cues.zh: 梦想客机还拥有绝对

cues.en: enormous range of up to 8,000
cues.zh: 惊人的航程，最高可达 8,000

cues.en: miles and better yet, it's efficient at that range.
cues.zh: 英里，更棒的是，它在如此远的航程下依然高效。

cues.en: Boeing made such a relatively small aircraft because they believe in an entirely different model of aviation,
cues.zh: 波音之所以制造这么一架相对较小的飞机，是因为他们坚信一种完全不同的航空运营模式，

cues.en: the point to point model. In this model, in order to get passengers from Hartford to London, airlines just run a direct flight between Hartford and London.
cues.zh: 即点对点模式。在这种模式下，为了把乘客从哈特福德送往伦敦，航空公司只需运营一趟从哈特福德直飞伦敦的航班。

cues.en: Obviously, demand would be lower, but there still is demand.
cues.zh: 显然，需求会降低，但需求依然存在。

cues.en: In the past, to fly a route like this, an airline would have to use an aircraft with higher capacity than demand because smaller airplanes couldn't fly such a distance nonstop.
cues.zh: 过去，要执飞这样的航线，航空公司必须使用运力高于需求的飞机，因为小飞机无法直飞这么远的距离。

cues.en: Given that, airlines resorted to the hub and spoke model to concentrate all the demand on certain routes where they could fill large long haul planes.
cues.zh: 鉴于此，航空公司采用“枢纽辐射”模式，将所有需求集中到某些航线上，以便坐满大型长途客机。

cues.en: Now with planes like the Dreamliner, airlines can fly long routes with less demand while still being efficient.
cues.zh: 现在有了像梦想客机这样的飞机，航空公司可以在需求较少长途航线上执飞，同时依然保持高效。

cues.en: The hub and spoke model was also popular in the past because airlines believed that it was more cost efficient to fly less flights at higher capacity.
cues.zh: 过去“枢纽辐射”模式很受欢迎，还因为航空公司认为，以更高运力减少航班次数会更具成本效益。

cues.en: It's simple economics really. Doing a lot of one thing together is cheaper than doing a lot of one thing separately. It's economies of scale.
cues.zh: 这其实就是简单的经济学。把大量同类事情集中做，比分开做更便宜。这就是规模效应。

cues.en: Except that doesn't really extend to the airline industry.
cues.zh: 只不过这在航空业并不怎么适用。

cues.en: For a larger aircraft, you need more ground staff, more flight attendants, more check-in agents, more fuel, more of pretty much everything.
cues.zh: 对于大型飞机，你需要更多的地勤人员、更多的空乘人员、更多的值机人员、更多的燃油，几乎每样东西都需要更多。

cues.en: The only cost that stays the same is pilots and the only ones reduced are gates and takeoffs.
cues.zh: 唯一保持不变的成本是飞行员，而唯一能减少的是登机口和起降次数。

cues.en: When you're now doing more flights at the largest most expensive airports, you end up spending more money. Airports like Hartford, Connecticut are cheap.
cues.zh: 当你在最大、最贵的机场运营更多航班时，最终反而会花掉更多钱。像康涅狄格州哈特福德这样的机场就很便宜。

cues.en: Labor is cheap. Takeoff fees are cheap. Everything costs less than at JFK or Newark. There are just fewer flights to compete with. Not only that, but flying direct flights clearly cost a ton less because airlines only have to pay the per flight costs that I talked about a lot in my why flying is so expensive video once rather than twice.
cues.zh: 人工便宜。起降费便宜。什么都比肯尼迪机场或纽瓦克机场便宜。只是竞争的航班较少罢了。不仅如此，直飞航班的成本显然要低得多，因为航空公司在我那期“为什么机票这么贵”的视频里讨论过的单趟飞行成本，只需要付一次，而不是两次。

cues.en: United Airlines was a major innovator of the point to point model with their Newark hub.
cues.zh: 美联航是点对点模式的重要创新者，以纽瓦克为枢纽。

cues.en: Newark is an airport suited to serve smaller planes,
cues.zh: 纽瓦克机场适合服务小型飞机，

cues.en: so United took the opportunity to open up direct flights to smaller destinations on the British Isles using narrow body planes stretched to the upper limits of their range. United primarily uses the Boeing seven fifty seven to reach smaller destinations like Shannon, Ireland, Belfast, Northern Ireland,
cues.zh: 所以美联航抓住机会，用航程拉到极限的窄体机开辟了直飞不列颠群岛较小目的地的航班。美联航主要用波音757飞往香农、北爱尔兰贝尔法斯特等较小目的地，

cues.en: Glasgow, Edinburgh, Scotland, and Manchester,
cues.zh: 苏格兰格拉斯哥、爱丁堡，以及曼彻斯特、

cues.en: Newcastle, and Birmingham, England. Often, the United flight from Newark is the only transatlantic flight serving these airports.
cues.zh: 英格兰纽卡斯尔和伯明翰。美联航从纽瓦克出发的航班往往是这些机场唯一的跨大西洋航班。

cues.en: United is able to operate these routes because the East Coast Of The US and the British Isles are just close enough together to reach with a narrow body plane.
cues.zh: 美联航能运营这些航线，是因为美国东海岸和不列颠群岛距离刚好够近，窄体机可以飞到。

cues.en: With the seven eighty seven, airlines are able to open even longer routes between smaller destinations.
cues.zh: 有了787，航空公司能在较小目的地之间开辟更长的航线。

cues.en: Routes like these are called long and skinny, long distance but skinny demand.
cues.zh: 这类航线叫“长而瘦”，距离长但需求小。

cues.en: These include routes like Tokyo to Seattle, London to Chennai, India, Wuhan, China to San Francisco,
cues.zh: 包括东京到西雅图、伦敦到印度金奈、中国武汉到旧金山、

cues.en: Beijing to Boston,
cues.zh: 北京到波士顿、

cues.en: Nairobi, Kenya to Paris,
cues.zh: 肯尼亚内罗毕到巴黎、

cues.en: Santiago,
cues.zh: 智利圣地亚哥

cues.en: Chile to Madrid, Warsaw, Poland to Beijing,
cues.zh: 到马德里、波兰华沙到北京、

cues.en: Doha to Edinburgh, Scotland, the list goes on. The efficiency of this plane has also allowed for an entirely new class of airline,
cues.zh: 多哈到苏格兰爱丁堡等等，不胜枚举。这款飞机的效率还催生了一类全新的航空公司，

cues.en: budget long haul carriers.
cues.zh: 廉价长途航空公司。

cues.en: The three main players in this category are Jetstar Airlines based in Australia,
cues.zh: 这一类别中的三家主要航空公司是总部位于澳大利亚的捷星航空（Jetstar Airlines）、

cues.en: Scoot Airlines based in Singapore, and Norwegian Airlines based in both Scandinavia and London.
cues.zh: 总部位于新加坡的酷航（Scoot Airlines），以及总部位于斯堪的纳维亚和伦敦的挪威航空（Norwegian Airlines）。

cues.en: Short haul budget airlines have been possible for a while because of efficient short range airplanes, but this really is the first time there has been such an efficient long haul airplane. So these three airlines use the reduction in operating cost to offer significantly lower ticket prices while also using the principles of budget airlines that outlined in my how budget airlines work video.
cues.zh: 得益于高效的短程飞机，短途廉价航空已经存在一段时间了，但这确实是首次出现如此高效的长途客机。因此，这三家航空公司利用运营成本的降低来大幅降低机票价格，同时也运用了我在“廉价航空如何运作”视频中介绍过的廉价航空原则。

cues.en: What's even more exciting for us consumers is the upcoming Boeing seven thirty seven max.
cues.zh: 对于我们消费者来说，更令人兴奋的是即将推出的波音 737 MAX。

cues.en: This plane is a redeveloped version of the long existing Boeing seven thirty seven featuring a larger capacity,
cues.zh: 这款飞机是历史悠久的波音 737 的重新开发版本，具有更大的载客量、

cues.en: longer range, and higher fuel efficiency. This means that we could conceivably see super low demand routes like Manchester to Cleveland, Lyon to New York, and Belfast to DC operated in the near future. Norwegian Airlines has already hinted at plans to use a seven thirty seven mac to open up an auxiliary transatlantic hub in Edinburgh,
cues.zh: 更远的航程和更高的燃油效率。这意味着我们未来很有可能会看到诸如曼彻斯特到克利夫兰、里昂到纽约以及贝尔法斯特到华盛顿这样的小众低需求航线。挪威航空已经暗示计划使用 737 MAX 在爱丁堡开辟一个跨大西洋的辅助枢纽，

cues.en: a relatively small city.
cues.zh: 爱丁堡是一个相对较小的城市。

cues.en: So the a three eighty was a failure. Airbus hasn't received a new order in years and it recently announced that it would be cutting back its production to only 12 a year. Meanwhile, the seven eighty seven has amassed almost 1,200
cues.zh: 所以 A380 失败了。空客已经多年没有收到新订单了，最近还宣布将把产量削减至每年仅 12 架。与此同时，737（应指787，但根据原文保留数字）已经积累了近 1200 个

cues.en: orders.
cues.zh: 订单。

cues.en: Point to point flying has always been better for the consumer, but with these recent innovations,
cues.zh: 点对点飞行对消费者一直更有利，但有了这些最新创新，

cues.en: it's now better for airlines too.
cues.zh: 现在对航空公司也更有利了。

cues.en: Given that, it's clear that point to point flying is truly the future of aviation.
cues.zh: 既然如此，很明显点对点飞行才是航空业的真正未来。
